integrity: Exact rational formula and binomial reduction supported by an analytic proof; a standalone checker independently compares exact sums, quadrature and simulated valuation rows. The asymptotic claim is proved analytically, not inferred from finite checks. No independent audit is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Fixed, allocation-independent balanced bundles, independent rate-one exponential agent–good utilities, and fixed bundle size r as the number n of agents grows. No claims for allocation adaptivity, shared utility realizations, dependent agents, unequal bundle sizes, or growing r. Possible equivalent unindexed research remains a priority risk.
title: Universal EFX survival and logarithmic satisfaction under balanced exponential lotteries
